decisions.reason: The existing message-146 MODIFY already updates the FAQ referral explanation to state that no-code mints send the commission and tickets to a random existing NFT holder.
The no-code recipient rule does not change the existing $5 commission and one-Small-plus-one-Big ticket award for successful coded referrals.
Changing the reward assigned on a no-code mint does not alter the independent ticket counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw reset rules.
The no-code reward allocation does not change which ticket counters, badges, or referral identifiers must appear in NFT metadata.
Awarding a Big Block ticket to a random existing holder on a no-code mint does not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, or ticket-holder eligibility rule.
The fallback reward for a mint without a referral code does not change the NFT mint number's role, persistence, or display locations as a referral code.
The source changes how rewards are assigned when no code is used, not the Chainlink VRF selection method, ticket weighting, or eligible-winner rule.

The candidate already records the $5 commission amount and primary-mint prize funding; the source changes the no-code recipient, which is owned by the source Requirement rather than the revenue split.
Awarding a Small Block ticket to a random existing holder on a no-code mint does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, or ticket-holder eligibility rule.
The no-code primary-mint reward rule does not change the required flat $10 royalty on secondary sales.
The source changes ticket and commission allocation for no-code mints, not how prize winners are announced or claim their prizes.
The no-code reward recipient rule does not change which sale types fund the prize pools or how long that funding continues.
